integrity: The universal upper bound is proved by an explicit decomposition into a nonnegative measure and a positive-type measure. The matching lower bound is an explicit nonnegative positive-definite witness. Numerical replay is only a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(n\ge5\), \(U=\{0,\pm1\}\), and the two-fold sumset \(2U\).
The result does not classify all extremizers.
An unindexed or differently phrased equivalent result remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact nearest-neighbor Shapiro doubling on finite cycles
